intro.text: Lord Shewrman, notorious in Elendel's high society as a dreadful party guest.

items.text: Shewrman was invited to the Yomen-Ostlin wedding dinner, his invitation meant as a snub to everyone who did not get one.

personality.text: Dull when sober, and usually a drunken fool; Steris counts him the least likable member of Elendel's upper class.
